scope: 保存済EC projectのJSONを直接読取。親のmotion ledgerは参照しつつedit.jsonのsource focusから期待座標を独立算出し、実nativeの全position key/anchor/scale/remapと比較。文字のglyph寸法はlayout-and-motionのsourceRectAtTime測定値を使用し、実保存doc/transform/timingと一致確認。最終MP4の表示/動き/実試聴/実機UI安全は未判定。

camera.timeBasis: saved keys.time is layer-relative; global time = start_time + keys.time /254016000000

text.metricsProvenance: glyph widths/heights are the production sourceRectAtTime ledger; independent font shaping/render bounds were not re-measured.
